title: Rajkumar Hirani Is Finally Entering the Streaming Wars — And He’s Bringing His Son Along
excerpt: The man behind 3 Idiots and Munna Bhai makes his OTT debut as producer with ‘Pritam and Pedro’ on JioHotstar. His son Vir Hirani stars alongside Arshad Warsi and Vikrant Massey.
body:
For two decades, Rajkumar Hirani has been one of Indian cinema’s most bankable names. *Munna Bhai M.B.B.S.*, *3 Idiots*, *PK*, *Sanju* — the man has a near-perfect record of turning warm, funny stories into massive box office events. And yet, until now, he’s stayed away from streaming entirely.

That changes on July 3, when *Pritam and Pedro* premieres on JioHotstar.

## The Setup

Details are still sparse, but here’s what we know. The show follows two unlikely men who stumble upon an abandoned ATM on a beach — and the mystery that unravels from there. Hirani describes it as a story “where very different people are forced to come together and navigate life in unexpected ways,” full of “humour, warmth and madness.”

If you’ve seen any Hirani film, you know exactly what that means. The man has essentially trademarked a specific emotional register — one that makes you laugh, cry, and leave the theatre feeling slightly better about humanity. The question is whether that magic translates to long-format storytelling.

## A Family Affair

Perhaps the most intriguing detail: *Pritam and Pedro* marks the screen debut of **Vir Hirani**, Rajkumar Hirani’s son. He’s joined by two actors who need no introduction — **Arshad Warsi** (Circuit himself, reuniting with the Hirani universe) and **Vikrant Massey**, who’s been on an extraordinary run with films like *12th Fail* and *Sector 36*.

The show is directed by **Avinash Arun**, the filmmaker behind *Paatal Lok* and the acclaimed Marathi film *Killa*. His sensibility — gritty, visually assured, psychologically layered — is a fascinating contrast to Hirani’s signature warmth. That tension could make this the most interesting OTT debut of 2026.

## Why NRIs Should Care

Here’s the real story for the diaspora: JioHotstar has been aggressively expanding its international footprint, and Hirani’s name alone will pull subscribers. For NRIs who grew up quoting “Aal Izz Well” and “Jaadu ki jhappi,” a Hirani-produced series is essentially appointment television.

The streaming landscape in India has been dominated by dark thrillers and crime dramas — *Paatal Lok*, *Sacred Games*, *Mirzapur*. A feel-good series from Hirani’s stable could be the counter-programming moment everyone’s been waiting for. Whether you’re in New Jersey, London, or Sydney, this one goes on the July watchlist.

## The Bigger Picture

Hirani’s move to streaming isn’t happening in isolation. Bollywood’s biggest names have been migrating to OTT — from Shah Rukh Khan reportedly eyeing a series to Aamir Khan’s streaming plans. But Hirani is the first of the “untouchable” filmmakers to take the plunge as a producer, and that signals something significant about where the industry sees its future.

*Pritam and Pedro* premieres July 3 on JioHotstar. Mark it.
